newsitem.title: USA: Shaw Group net leaps despite strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: Shaw Group net leaps despite strong dollar.

text.p: The Shaw Group Inc Monday said its net income for the second quarter almost doubled from last year on sharply higher sales, although a stronger dollar had helped curb international power project bookings.
For the second quarter ended February 28, the company reported record sales of $85,515,993, a jump of 52 percent from the $56,374,713 seen during the same period last fiscal year.
It reported net income of $3,588,407, or $0.31 per share, compared to net income of $1,801,373, or $0.20 per share, for the same period in fiscal 1996.

The company said revenues for the second quarter and first six months of fiscal 1997 were buttressed by fabrication and bending projects performed at NAPTech, Inc., the company's fabrication and induction bending facility in Clearfield, Utah.
